items.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
items.description: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

items.title: Apple's iPhone Duo is proving itself the catalyst that Jim Cramer said it would be
items.description: Preorders of Apple's iPhone Duo are proving Jim Cramer right, as early indications show strong demand.

items.title: Saudi Arabia postpones big investor conference to 2027 as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on kingdom
items.description: Iran-backed Houthi militants have launched repeated volleys of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia since a deadly airport attack earlier this month.

items.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
items.description: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.

items.title: Anthropic is AI trade's last big hope for a major IPO this year
items.description: On Kalshi, Anthropic is seen as the last major IPO in 2026 after OpenAI delayed its public market debut. Others have postponed too.

items.title: Cornell sexual assault case has some prospective students rethinking plans, consultants say
items.description: Some prospective Cornell University students are rethinking applications amid the Jane Doe sexual assault lawsuit, college admissions consultants say.

items.title: OpenAI bugging suspect's conduct could pose danger to U.S. national security, feds warn
items.description: Saudi national Abdulrahman Alfozan is accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at OpenAI headquarters in San Francisco.

items.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
items.description: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

items.title: NYSE becomes latest exchange to extend options hours as appetite for around-the-clock trading grows
items.description: The New York Stock Exchange becomes second major exchange to announce extended-hours options trading for heavily traded ETFs and single stocks, following CBOE.

items.title: Google says it can build data centers the right way. Some experts and residents are skeptical
items.description: Google says its Minnesota AI data center will add clean energy to the grid and protect ratepayers. Experts question whether grid upgrades are needed.

items.title: French unrest compounds debt crisis fears. Paris-listed stocks, bonds and the euro fall
items.description: "It looks like either the bond markets riot, or the people riot, or both," one analyst told CNBC.

items.title: Boomers are buying into the promise of monthly income from options ETFs, but there's a tax catch
items.description: Covered call ETFs have been widely adopted by baby boomers to meet monthly income needs, but unlike most ETFs, the tax implications can be significant.

items.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
items.description: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.

items.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new public benefit fund that could address AI job disruption
items.description: The Claude maker said that establishing the fund as an LLC will provide greater flexibility in how the money is used.

items.title: Putin reportedly proposes three-way summit with Trump and Xi on Ukraine war — without Zelenskyy
items.description: The report comes amid mounting tensions between Ukraine and the United States, its largest military backer.

items.title: India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit
items.description: Sitharaman identified fuel, fertilizer and access to capital as risks for India’s economy in 2027.

items.title: In pictures: More than 500,000 took to the streets as France protests erupted into violence
items.description: Over 500,000 people took part in protests in France over the weekend, which became marred by violence, amid demonstrations against rising living costs.

items.title: China's CXMT shares fall nearly 8% as investors look past chipmaker's profit turnaround
items.description: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.

items.title: Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi rejects criticism around weak yen and high interest rates
items.description: The prime minister denied that her policies were responsible for the yen’s weakness or rising JGB yields.

items.title: China's third-quarter economic growth quickens to 4.5% as exports surge, beating estimates
items.description: China's economic growth accelerated in the third quarter, as foreign demand for the country's technological goods largely offset sluggish consumer demand.
